rows.reason: Fault fixed: 'above his company' now cited to lines 32 and 33; 'till his manners gave a disgust' (l.31) and 'proud' (l.32) verbatim; meaning drawn before the key's wording; Bingley's anger at the ball closing correctly placed at line 37.

Fault fixed: 'Named things went in the first box to be returned.' cited to lines 7 and 8; the Friday box is now linked to 'the charity collection on Friday morning' (lines 8 and 9), so 'the Friday box' (l.33) shows which rule bends; lines 13-14 and 31-32 described truly; 5 sentences, each 16 words or fewer.

Quotations and lines are right ('passed the noticeboard' l.37, 'September football trials' l.38, 'It won't fit me next year.' l.47), and 'September trials belong to next year too' is a fair school-year inference (Ilya's 'When we're in Year Six', l.15). But the step the key rests on, 'he is already giving up on next year', is asserted, not shown: the only evidence cited is a size reason ('won't fit me'), which a child will read as simply outgrowing the jumper. Ground it in lines that show the reason is not the whole story, e.g. he returns even a leaver's cardigan (l.14) yet puts his own named jumper in 'the Friday box' (l.33), and Miss Bhatt 'looked at him for a second or two longer than the answer needed' (l.48). The key remains the one defensible answer; the fault is in the script.

Fault fixed: 'to be returned' cited to lines 7 and 8, 'the charity collection' to lines 8 and 9; 'had left in Year Four' (l.13) and 'anyway' (l.14) verbatim; the return-over-charity step to the key is sound.

Replacement is the approved script with only the citation corrected: 'dulled hearing' now cited to lines 18 and 19 (it spans them) and set in quotation marks; every other sentence unchanged and true, so at least as good in every respect.

Replacement keeps the approved script and corrects the citation: 'she began to fear' on line 14, 'flying about from one place to another' now cited to lines 14 and 15; dinner (ll.9-11) earlier and guests (ll.17-18) later remain true; at least as good in every respect.
